learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to use hand gestures and body movements to tell amazing stories without speaking a single word!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: In Indian dance, we use special hand signs called Mudras to show things like a blooming lotus or a flying bird. Your hands can talk!
You do not need a voice to tell a tale! Dancers use their beautiful bodies to act out exciting adventures and myths.
A dancer can change from a brave warrior to a frightened deer just by changing the way they stand and look.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Silent Animal Story!
fun_activity.instructions: Use only your hands and face to act like a hungry monkey finding a banana. Ask your friends to guess what animal you are playing!

quick_recap: ⭐ Mudras are beautiful hand gestures that help us show objects and animals.
⭐ Dancers can tell long, exciting stories using only their bodies.
⭐ Changing our posture helps us play many different characters in one dance.
